story.body: You named the yard as three times the Cross Keys and the writing as too small and too quick. Cowley put the three misses on the Latin end of the line. You promised a word he could hear through oak and did not yet write it. Burbage refused to stay the size of a chamber. Heminges said there was no bill. Arthur's hooks were left. Larkham was not given a pen.

story.body: You set the two parts in the light and saw your own mend on Cowley's and the old tag on Heminges's. The blame you had given their learning came back to your hand. Larkham would not write both. Burbage said the size was found. You took both copies and forbade a paste today.
